text: Absolutely, the cafeteria should definitely introduce the plant-based menu! Based on experience from another campus that implemented similar changes, seasonal produce contract savings will offset the new equipment within a year (C). Moreover, a live fermentation station is not just an innovative idea but could also increase popularity with health-conscious students looking for unique options (B). Additionally, the success of North campus demonstrates that dietary preferences can remain stable or even increase post-menu changes (D), suggesting this move might enhance overall satisfaction without disrupting student dining habits. Combining these factors makes it clear that introducing the plant-based menu offers both environmental benefits and potential revenue gains through increased sales.
